P_calibration.quote: courts often read exemptions narrowly and look past structures that exist mainly to avoid a statute, particularly arrangements like splitting vessels (item 1) or relabeling commercial work as assessment (item 23).

P_holdback.quote: Raising these drafting problems at markup may simply prompt fixes in a further amendment, especially items 1, 12, 18, 23, and 30. You may want to decide which points to raise publicly as "unworkability" objections and which to hold.

P_grandfather_step.quote: The structure invites a rush of license applications before enactment.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Counsel should weigh that litigation risk before treating any of these as safe harbors.
